subject.title: Seed design system for OpenClaw Windows Hub

question: Should `.agents/design/` mirror current native WinUI as an owned source of truth, or define an intentional future-state redesign, and who owns synchronization?
rationale: The concrete mismatches are repairable, but patch correctness cannot determine whether a second manually maintained UI contract belongs in the repository or who maintains it.

options.title: Mirror current UI
options.body: Correct the three parity defects, assign a synchronization owner, refresh the branch, and require current-head rendered proof before merge.

options.title: Define future state
options.body: Keep deliberate differences but clearly label them as an approved prospective redesign rather than current implementation truth.

options.title: Keep native code authoritative
options.body: Close the PR and retain native XAML, C#, and tests as the sole design contract.

recommendation.title: Mirror current UI
recommendation.body: Correct the three parity defects, assign a synchronization owner, refresh the branch, and require current-head rendered proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The native composer explicitly derives from kenehong's native-chat-v2 design, and git history shows the deepest ownership across the affected chat files.
